findings.label: OpenAPI schema incomplete
findings.description: LTI routes and request/response schemas not added to packages/api/openapi.yaml. Update packages/api/src/openapi.ts to register LTI path definitions and schemas.

findings.label: Insights bearer token path not implemented
findings.description: packages/api/src/routes/insights.ts accepts bearer token but does not verify LTI instructor role. Implement the LTI instructor authorization path: parse bearer token, validate session, check insightsAccess flag.

findings.label: Nonce/state/token-hash store is in-memory
findings.description: stateToNonce, tokenHashSeen, and nonceSeen will not survive API restart or horizontal scaling. Move to Redis or PostgreSQL with expiry.

findings.label: Test assertion incorrect
findings.description: p10-lti.test.ts line 156 test fails because mock function does not throw as expected. Fix to use actual jose library validation or proper stub.

findings.label: Platform registry not validated
findings.description: Session creation does not validate platform registration or deployment ID match. platformConfigs initialized empty by default. Clarify how platform configs are loaded and ensure deployment validation.
